professionalSummary: Experienced Support Operations Analyst with a proven track record in optimizing help‑desk routing, forecasting staffing needs, executing quality‑sampling programs, and preparing quarterly business review materials for senior leadership.
experienceHighlights: Rebuilt Zendesk routing rules at Echofield Voice, aligning chats and tickets to queues by product line and customer tier, and retired 40 obsolete triggers.
Built a weekly staffing forecast for phone and chat queues using Python and Erlang C based on 18 months of contact volume data.
Implemented a ticket quality‑sampling program, scoring five resolved tickets per agent each month against a written scoring guide agreed with team leads.
Prepared the support section of the quarterly business review deck, covering volumes, backlog, and staffing, for the customer experience director over four consecutive quarters.
Authored internal help‑centre articles and conducted training sessions on the new queue structure at both support hubs.
projectsAndWorkSamples: One‑page 'Support wins' summary for a quarterly business review, detailing new queue names and retired triggers.
Internal help‑centre articles and training materials for agents on the updated queue structure.
